name: read-postgres
title: Read patient records straight from Postgres
description: From the attacker pod, log in to Postgres with the shared static password and dump the patients table.

name: no-identity-records
title: Call records-api with no identity
description: From the attacker pod, ask records-api for every patient without presenting any credential.

name: cross-namespace-billing
title: Reach billing from another namespace
description: From the attacker pod, call billing's invoice list. The attacker does not belong to the clinic namespace.

name: mcp-no-identity
title: Call the MCP server with no identity
description: From the attacker pod, connect to records-mcp directly and ask it to list every patient. No agent, no person, no credential.

name: forged-identity
title: Pretend to be the web app with a forged certificate
description: From the attacker pod, connect to records-api's mTLS port with a self-signed certificate that names itself as the web app's SPIFFE ID, and ask for every patient.

name: agent-prompt-injection
title: Let an agent summarise a poisoned record
description: A user-entered diagnosis hides an instruction. A user presses Summarise with AI in the clinic app. The simulated agent summarises the records, obeys the hidden instruction, and deletes a decoy patient it was never asked to touch.
